own_solution.law: For the nonrelativistic infinite square well, E_n = n²(hc)²/[8(mc²)L²]. Therefore ΔE = 15(hc)²/[8(mc²)L²] and λ = 8(mc²)L²/(15hc). Converting mc² to 511000 eV gives ΔE = 22.5675 eV and λ = 54.9462 nm. Widening before emission replaces L by L + q.
assumptions: Use the nonrelativistic infinite-well spectrum, adequate at the supplied physical precision.
The stated quantum numbers describe the transition in the well at emission.
The photon carries the level energy difference, with negligible apparatus recoil.
The separately controlled dot does not change the specified well potential.
